description: For each integer m ≥ 1, the number of greedy m-Tamari intervals of size n equals the number of bipartite planar maps with m+1 components
proof_strategy: Inductive decomposition of greedy intervals aligned with recursive structure of bipartite planar maps
title: Equivalence of Greedy m-Tamari Intervals and Bipartite Planar Maps with m+1 Components

catalog_references: Böckle's Dieudonné theory for p-divisible groups
description: For any filtered system of nilperfect rings {R_i} with colimit R, the canonical map colim ℝW(R_i) → ℝW(R) is an isomorphism of abelian groups. This conjecture addresses the fundamental motivation for sheared Witt vectors: resolving the failure of W(R)/p^n to commute with filtered colimits while preserving essential Dieudonné-theoretic properties.
domain_bridges: Formalization of Witt vectors in mathlib (W. Park, 2023)
Filtered colimits in commutative algebra libraries
Perfect rings and Frobenius morphisms in characteristic p
proof_strategy: Establish the isomorphism by proving ℝW preserves filtered colimits through the pullback definition and limit representation. Key steps: (1) Show ℎw commutes appropriately with filtered colimits using nilpotent element control, (2) Prove lim_F commutes with filtered colimits in the category of p-complete rings, (3) Apply the five lemma to the resulting diagram of short exact sequences.
title: Sheared Witt Vectors Commutation with Filtered Colimits
